title: Matrix<T, Rows, Cols>
requirements: Dimensions as template parameters; storage `std::array<T, R * C>`
`operator*` only compiles when inner dimensions match: `Matrix<T,R,K> * Matrix<T,K,C> → Matrix<T,R,C>`
`transpose()` returns `Matrix<T,C,R>`; `identity()` only for square (constrain with `requires (R == C)`)
